module.purpose: Implements React's lazy() API for deferring component module loading, managing initialization state machine and optional async debug info.
module.summary: This module provides the lazy function that wraps a dynamic import callback into a LazyComponent object understood by React's reconciler. It defines a payload state machine (uninitialized, pending, resolved, rejected) and the lazyInitializer that resolves the thenable, mutating payload status and result. In development with async debug info enabled, it tracks performance timing and promise introspection for DevTools.
module.businessContext: Supports code-splitting in React apps. If broken, lazy-loaded components fail to render or throw incorrect errors.

detail.name: lazyInitializer
preconditions: payload must be a valid Payload<T> object with _status and _result properties
when _status is Uninitialized, payload._result must be callable (a constructor returning a thenable)
when _status is Resolved, payload._result must be a module object (possibly with a default export)
postconditions: if payload._status is Resolved after initialization, returns moduleObject.default
if payload._status is not Resolved after initialization, throws payload._result
on successful ctor invocation, attaches thenable handlers that transition payload to Resolved or Rejected
invariants: payload state transitions follow: Uninitialized -> Pending -> Resolved | Rejected
thenable handlers only execute state transitions if payload._status is Pending or Uninitialized
the payload's _status is never set back to Uninitialized once transitioned
thenable.status is only set once (if undefined) to either 'fulfilled' or 'rejected'
edgeCases: Uninitialized payload: ctor is invoked, thenable handlers attached, payload transitions to Pending and throws the thenable
Resolved payload with moduleObject === undefined (DEV): logs console.error about expected dynamic import() result, then returns undefined.default which throws TypeError
Resolved payload without 'default' property (DEV): logs console.error about missing default export, then returns undefined which throws TypeError
Rejected payload: skips initialization, throws payload._result (the error/rejection reason)
Pending payload: skips initialization, throws payload._result (the pending thenable)
Thenable with status already defined: does not overwrite the status/value/reason annotations
Synchronous ctor throw: exception propagates out of lazyInitializer without transitioning payload state

raises: whatever payload._result holds (Error, rejection reason, or pending thenable)

stateMutations: payload._status (set to Resolved, Rejected, or Pending)
payload._result (set to moduleObject, error, or thenable)
thenable.value (set to moduleObject, if status was undefined)
thenable.reason (set to error, if status was undefined)
detail.summary: Initializes a lazily-loaded React component by invoking the payload's constructor, transitioning the payload through pending/resolved/rejected states, and returning the resolved module's default export or throwing the pending/rejected result.

detail.name: lazy
detail.signature: export function lazy<T>(ctor: () => Thenable<{default: T, ...}>,): LazyComponent<T, Payload<T>>
preconditions: The ctor parameter must be a function returning a Thenable
The Thenable must resolve to an object containing a 'default' key
postconditions: Returns a LazyComponent object with $$typeof set to REACT_LAZY_TYPE
The returned object's _payload has _status set to Uninitialized and _result set to ctor
The returned object's _init is set to lazyInitializer
When __DEV__ and enableAsyncDebugInfo are both true, payload._ioInfo and lazyType._debugInfo are populated with debug metadata
invariants: The returned LazyComponent's $$typeof is always REACT_LAZY_TYPE
The _payload._status is always Uninitialized at creation time
The _payload._result always equals the ctor argument passed in
edgeCases: When __DEV__ and enableAsyncDebugInfo are both true: payload._ioInfo is set to a ReactIOInfo object with name 'lazy', and lazyType._debugInfo is set to an array containing one awaited info entry
When either __DEV__ is false or enableAsyncDebugInfo is false: _ioInfo and _debugInfo fields are not set on the payload or lazyType
The ctor is stored as-is in _result without being called; resolution is deferred to lazyInitializer at render time
stateMutations: Creates a new payload object of type Payload<T>
Creates a new lazyType object of type LazyComponent<T, Payload<T>>
Does not mutate the ctor parameter or any external state
detail.summary: Creates a lazy-loadable React component that defers loading its implementation until first render, storing the constructor in a payload object and returning a LazyComponent type object marked with REACT_LAZY_TYPE.
